skill.name: claude-scientific-skills
skill.description: Guidance for scientific research and analysis workflows in Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
skill.summary: Apply structured guidance to scientific research and analysis tasks.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is a prompt-only guide with no executable code, scripts, or tool automation. The two static network findings are documentation and source repository URLs, not runtime network access or data transfer.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL appears in frontmatter as a source repository reference. It does not trigger network access or transmit user data.
The URL is a markdown link to the source repository for more information. It is not executable behavior and does not create a network exfiltration path.

content.value_statement: Scientific work needs clear structure before analysis begins. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code simple guidance for research-focused reasoning.
actual_capabilities: Guides users on when to apply scientific research and analysis support.
Provides a concise overview for research-focused assistant behavior.
Offers general patterns for scientific research and analysis tasks.
Links users to the upstream source repository for additional context.
Works as a prompt-only skill across Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
limitations: Does not include domain-specific methods, formulas, or validation checks.
Does not access papers, datasets, or external scientific databases by itself.
Does not run code, statistical tests, or laboratory calculations.
Requires the user to provide research material and evaluation criteria.

use_cases.title: Structure a Literature Review
use_cases.description: Organize a research question, evidence themes, and analysis goals before reviewing scientific material.

use_cases.title: Plan Research Analysis
use_cases.description: Turn a broad scientific topic into a clear analysis workflow with scope, assumptions, and outputs.

use_cases.title: Support Technical Review
use_cases.description: Use a consistent research-analysis frame when reviewing scientific notes, summaries, or draft findings.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Research Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me structure a scientific research review on this topic. Identify the research question, scope, key concepts, and first analysis steps.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Research Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these scientific notes and organize them into claims, supporting evidence, assumptions, uncertainties, and follow-up questions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Scientific Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these scientific findings. Highlight agreements, conflicts, methodological limits, and what evidence would strengthen the conclusion.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Analysis Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for planning a full analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a structured analysis workflow for this research problem. Include inputs, evaluation criteria, reasoning steps, expected outputs, and validation checks.

output_examples.input: I need to review studies about a proposed material for battery storage.
output_examples.output: The assistant would define the research question, separate performance and safety evidence, list key measurements, and flag missing comparison data.

output_examples.input: I have notes from several papers and need a useful synthesis.
output_examples.output: The assistant would group claims by theme, summarize supporting evidence, identify contradictions, and propose follow-up questions for review.

output_examples.input: I need an analysis plan before evaluating a dataset from an experiment.
output_examples.output: The assistant would outline inputs, assumptions, analysis steps, quality checks, and the expected form of the final findings.

best_practices: Provide the research question, domain, and intended output before asking for analysis.
Include source excerpts or notes when asking for evidence review.
Ask the assistant to separate facts, assumptions, and uncertainties.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the skill as a substitute for expert scientific review.
Do not ask for conclusions without providing evidence or source material.
Do not use it to validate experiments without independent checks.

faq.question: Does this skill include scientific databases?
faq.answer: No. It provides prompt guidance only and does not connect to external databases.

faq.question: Can it analyze papers I provide?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the relevant text or notes, and the assistant can help structure the analysis.

faq.question: Does it run statistical analysis?
faq.answer: No. It does not include executable code or statistical tooling.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it make scientific claims on its own?
faq.answer: No. It needs user-provided evidence and should present uncertainties clearly.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the research question, source material, constraints, and the type of output you need.
